notes: Read card names from the 1024x512 original gallery screenshot before fetching rank21 list. Each position corresponds to one visible black quantity badge.
Artwork and visible lettering support name-level 38-cell reconstruction. All Japanese physical set/collector IDs remain unreadable or unverified.
R3C5 shows the magenta ACE SPEC Megaton Blower (メガトンブロアー); R3C6 Muscle Band (ちからのハチマキ), which is a Pokémon Tool.
R4C4 Parallel City (パラレルシティ) and R4C5 gold Path to the Peak (頂への雪道) were discriminated with official Japanese artwork or independent photographed card references.

Rank21 printed decklist exactly matches photo name counts, but multiple entrants could submit identical lists. Swiss rank 16 is not final placing 16. Do not infer Natsumegu is Shun Nakajima without direct attribution. Source ranks 23/25/28 remain missing.
